dependencies.name: qtbase
dependencies.$comment: wayland on Linux: QWindowKit's Linux code uses QNativeInterface::QWaylandApplication, which only exists in a Qt built with it (docs/LINUX_WSL.md)

dependencies.name: qthttpserver
dependencies.$comment: The page a room serves to guests, on the WebSocket's port (docs/PEERS.md §6.1). From the overlay in cmake/ports, which builds it with qtwebsockets

dependencies.name: curl
dependencies.$comment: HTTP for remote assets (docs/REMOTE_ASSETS.md §8). Without the default features: no FTP, SMTP and the rest. ssl is Windows' own TLS (Schannel) there, so no second OpenSSL beside PySide6's, and OpenSSL elsewhere

dependencies.name: pugixml
dependencies.$comment: The XML that WebDAV listings come in (docs/WEBDAV_RESOLVER.md §3)

dependencies.name: joltphysics
dependencies.$comment: Jolt Physics, the first physics backend (docs/PHYSICS.md). rtti: the backend subclasses JPH::GroupFilter, and GCC only emits a class's typeinfo with its key function, inside a Jolt built without RTTI by default
